---

Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

<actions string="" />

<traits>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 366 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Traditions**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until your next daily preparations
</row>

</column>

---

Vitality radiates outward from you, allowing others to supplicate and receive healing. Once per round, either you or an ally can use an Interact action to supplicate and lay hands upon you to regain Hit Points. Each time the beacon heals someone, it decreases in strength. It restores 4d10 Hit Points to the first creature, 4d8 Hit Points to the second, 4d6 Hit Points to the third, and 4d4 Hit Points to the fourth, after which the spell ends. You can have only one _vital beacon_ active at a time.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The beacon restores one additional die of HP each time it heals, using the normal die size for that step.
name: Vital Beacon

<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Force" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=75" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 367 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Deities**
[Casandalee](/Deities.aspx?ID=34), [Gravelady's Guard](/Deities.aspx?ID=247), [Grundinnar](/Deities.aspx?ID=88), [Isis](/Deities.aspx?ID=54), [Nethys](/Deities.aspx?ID=288)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You form an [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) wall of pure magical force up to 50 feet long and up to 20 feet high. The wall has no discernible thickness. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall blocks physical effects from passing through it, and because it's made of force, it blocks [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=222) and [ethereal](/Equipment.aspx?ID=284) creatures as well. [Teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156) effects can pass through the barrier, as can [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) effects (since the wall is invisible).

 _Wall of force_ is immune to effects of its rank or lower that attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) it. The wall is automatically destroyed by a [_disintegrate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=76) spell of any rank.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The Hit Points of the wall increases by 20.
name: Wall of Force

<title level="1" right="Spell 5" pfs="Standard">
[Wall of Ice](/Spells.aspx?ID=1750)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=27" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 367 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You sculpt an ice barrier that blocks sight and, once shattered, freezes foes. You create either a 1-foot-thick wall of ice in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high (the wall doesn't have to be vertical, but it must be anchored on both sides to a solid surface) or a 1-foot-thick, 10-foot radius hemisphere of ice. The ice that makes up the wall is opaque. If you wish, the wall can be of a smaller length, height, or radius. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

 Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 40 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits, cold damage, and precision damage. A section also has weakness to fire 15; a section of the wall destroyed by fire melts, evaporating into water and steam. A section destroyed by means other than fire leaves behind a chilling mass of ice that is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) and deals 2d6 cold damage to any creature passing through it.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 10, and the cold damage dealt to creatures crossing a destroyed section increases by 1d6.
name: Wall of Ice

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 368 2.0 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Deities** [General Susumu](/Deities.aspx?ID=306), [Horus](/Deities.aspx?ID=53) **Lesson** [Lesson of Snow](/Lessons.aspx?ID=23) **Range** 120 feet **Duration** 1 minute --- You create a barrier of gusting winds that hinders anything moving through it. The wall of swirling winds is 5 feet thick, 60 feet long, and 30 feet high. The wall stands vertically, but you can shape its path. Though the wall of wind distorts the air, it does not hamper sight. The wall has the following effects.
  • Ammunition from physical ranged attacks—such as arrows, bolts, sling bullets, and other objects of similar size—can't pass through the wall. Attacks with bigger ranged weapons, such as [javelins](/Weapons.aspx?ID=71), take a –2 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through the wall. Massive ranged weapons and spell effects that don't create physical objects pass through the wall with no penalty.
  • The wall is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) to creatures attempting to move overland through it. Gases, including creatures in [_vapor form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1738), can't pass through the wall.
  • A creature that attempts to fly through the wall using a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114) action must attempt a Fortitude save.
**Critical Success** The creature can move through the wall normally this turn.
**Success** The flying creature can move through the wall this turn, but the wall is difficult terrain.
**Failure** The wall stops the movement of the flying creature, and any remaining movement from its current action is wasted.
**Critical Failure** As failure, and the creature is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet away from the wall.
name: Wall of Wind

</row>

You bypass your targets' rational minds, instilling them with unshakable conviction and zeal. ---

You mime an invisible 10-foot-by-10-foot wall adjacent to you and within your reach. The wall is solid to those creatures that don't disbelieve it, even incorporeal creatures. You and your allies can voluntarily believe the wall exists to continue to treat it as solid, for instance to climb onto it. A creature that disbelieves the illusion is temporarily immune to your _house of imaginary walls_ for 1 minute. The wall doesn't block creatures that didn't see your visual performance, nor does it block objects. The wall has AC 10, Hardness equal to double the spell's rank, and HP equal to quadruple the spell's rank.
name: House of Imaginary Walls

<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />
<trait label="Composition" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=31" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=106" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 371 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 60-foot emanation

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You maintain a brisk performance that keeps allies on the move. You and your allies in the area can [Hustle](/Actions.aspx?ID=515) for the spell's duration, in addition to your other exploration activities (your exploration activity is Sustaining this spell). You and your allies then become temporarily immune for 1 day. If you enter an encounter while performing this song, you can use your [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) modifier for the initiative roll. You and your affected allies also receive a +1 status bonus to that initiative roll.

---
**Heightened (6th)** You can Sustain the Spell for up to 2 hours.

**Heightened (9th)** You can Sustain the Spell for up to 4 hours.
name: Song of Marching

<title level="1" right="Focus 5" pfs="Standard">
[Symphony of the Unfettered Heart](/Spells.aspx?ID=1777)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
<trait label="Composition" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=31" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 371 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** you or 1 ally
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your symphony lifts listeners from their worldly concerns. Attempt a [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) check to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) an effect applying one of the following conditions to the target: [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20), [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=33), [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35), or [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36). If you fail, you can't target the same effect on the target for 1 day. Use the condition's source to determine the counteract DC (for example, the [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) DC for grabbed).

---
**Heightened (9th)** You can target up to four creatures.
name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart

<actions string="Single Action" />

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 372 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** 1 ally
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 round
</row>

</column>

---

Your performance makes allies feel they can succeed at anything. This counts as having prepared to [Aid](/Actions.aspx?ID=75) your ally on a skill check of your choice. When you later use the Aid reaction, you can roll [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) instead of the normal skill check, and if you roll a failure, you get a success instead. If you are legendary in Performance, you automatically critically succeed. The GM might rule that you can't use this ability if the act of encouraging your ally would interfere with the skill check (such as a check to [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=63) quietly or maintain a disguise).
name: Uplifting Overture

<title level="1" right="Focus 4" pfs="Standard">
[Disperse into Air](/Spells.aspx?ID=1781)
<actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />

<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=127" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 372 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Air](/Domains.aspx?ID=65)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** You take damage from an enemy or a hazard

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

After taking the triggering damage, you transform into air. Until the end of the current turn, you can't be attacked or targeted, you don't take up space, you can't act, and any auras or emanations you have are suppressed. At the end of the turn, you re-form in any space you can occupy within 15 feet of where you were when you dispersed. Any auras or emanations you had are restored as long as their duration didn't run out while you were dispersed.
name: Disperse into Air

**Critical Failure** As success, but the creature automatically follows a suggestion that advances its own ambitions.

---

Your competitiveness drives you to prove yourself against the opposition. You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks. If an enemy within 20 feet critically succeeds at an attack roll or skill check, your status bonus increases to +3 for attack rolls or that specific skill check (whichever the foe critically succeeded at) for 1 round.

---
**Heightened (7th)** Increase the base bonus to +2 and the increased bonus after an enemy critically succeeds to +4.

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</row>

---

While in a crowd of roughly similar creatures, your appearance becomes bland and nondescript. You gain a +2 status bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) and [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks to go incognito among the crowd, and you ignore [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) caused by the crowd. This counts as setting up a disguise for the [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) use of Deception and you add your level even if you're untrained.

---
**Heightened (3rd)** The spell gains a range of 10 feet and can target up to 10 creatures.
name: Face in the Crowd

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 372 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Cities](/Domains.aspx?ID=66)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 25 miles

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 8 hours
</row>

</column>

---

You tap into the zeitgeist of any settlements in range. You learn the names of the settlements. On all [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about those settlements or to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=49) in or about those settlements, you gain a +2 status bonus and use your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained. When you Cast the Spell, you can immediately Recall Knowledge about one of the settlements using its Lore skill (such as Absalom Lore), which benefits from the bonus. If you cast _pulse of civilization_ again, any previous casting ends.

---
**Heightened (5th)** The range is 100 miles.

**Heightened (7th)** The range is 500 miles and the bonus is +3.
name: Pulse of Civilization

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 373 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Creation](/Domains.aspx?ID=68)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 15 feet

**Target** 1 item or work of art that fits entirely within the range
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You transform the target into a form that more closes matches your creative vision. It's clearly the same item, but with aesthetic details you choose. The target is a beautiful and impressive piece for its new quality, but the effect is obviously magical and temporary, so its monetary value doesn't change. If you're an expert in [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4), the item grants a +1 item bonus to attack rolls if it's a weapon or skill checks if it's a skill tool. When you Cast this Spell, any previous casting ends.

---
**Heightened (7th)** If you're a master in Crafting, the item grants a +2 item bonus.

**Heightened (10th)** If you're legendary in Crafting, the item grants a +3 item bonus.
name: Artistic Flourish

<title level="1" right="Focus 1" pfs="Standard">
[Cloak of Shadow](/Spells.aspx?ID=1790)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Aura" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=206" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Darkness" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=39" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Shadow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=143" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 373 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Darkness](/Domains.aspx?ID=69)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 willing creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You drape the target in a mantle of swirling shadows that make it harder to see. The cloak reduces [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) within a 20-foot emanation to [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408). This is a form of magical [darkness](/Traits.aspx?ID=39) and can therefore overcome non-magical light or attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) magical light as described on page 431.

 The target can use [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) condition gained from the shadows to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62), though observant creatures can still follow the moving aura of shadow, making it difficult for the target to become completely [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39). The target can use an Interact action to remove the cloak and leave it behind as a decoy, where it remains, reducing light for the rest of the spell's duration. If anyone picks up the cloak after it's been removed by the original target, the cloak evaporates and the spell ends.
name: Cloak of Shadow

<traits>

<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Prediction" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=132" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 375 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Fate](/Domains.aspx?ID=75)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature other than you
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You attempt to learn more about the target's fate in the short term, usually within the next day for most prosaic creatures, or the next hour or less for someone likely to have multiple rapid experiences, such as someone actively adventuring.

 You learn a single enigmatic word connected to the creature's fate in that time frame. Fate is notoriously inscrutable, and the word isn't necessarily meant to be taken at face value, so the meaning is often clear only in hindsight. The GM rolls a secret DC 6 flat check. If the creature's fate is too uncertain, or on a failed flat check, the spell yields the word “inconclusive.” Either way, the creature is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.
name: Read Fate

[Fate](/Domains.aspx?ID=75)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** You or an ally within range attempts a saving throw

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

**Target** the triggering creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You twist the forces of fate to make a moment dire or uneventful, with no in-between. The target gains a +1 status bonus to the triggering saving throw. If the saving throw's result is a success, it becomes a critical success. If it's a failure, it becomes a critical failure, and the critical failure can't be reduced by abilities that usually reduce critical failure.

If the triggering ability did not have both a critical success and critical failure condition, tempt fate fails, but you don't expend the Focus Point for Casting this Spell.

---
**Heightened (8th)** The bonus on the saving throw is +2.
name: Tempt Fate

<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 375 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Freedom](/Domains.aspx?ID=77)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 round
</row>

</column>

---

You utter a liberating word of power that frees a creature. You suppress one of the following conditions of your choice: [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=33). The target isn't affected by the chosen condition, and if you suppress the grabbed or restrained condition, the target automatically breaks free from the grab or restraint when you Cast the Spell.

 If you don't remove the effect that provided the condition, the condition returns after the spell ends. For example, if a spell was making the target confused for 1 minute, _word of freedom_ would let the target act normally for a round, but the confused condition would return afterward.
name: Word of Freedom

This spell attempts to progress a disease affliction, a poison affliction, or persistent poison damage affecting the target. If the target is affected by more than one of these, choose from among those you are aware of; otherwise, the GM chooses randomly. An unwilling target can attempt a Will save to negate take its course. The effect of this spell depends on whether you're attempting to end an affliction or persistent poison damage, and whether you are attempting to help or hinder the target's recovery.
  • **Affliction** The target immediately attempts its next saving throw against the affliction. You can grant the creature your choice of a +2 status bonus or a –2 status penalty to its saving throw against the affliction.
  • **Persistent Poison** You can cause the target to take the [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) immediately when you Cast this Spell (in addition to taking it at the end of its next turn). Whether or not you do so, the target attempts an additional flat check against the persistent poison damage. You can set the DC of that flat check to 5 or 20 instead of the normal DC.
--- **Heightened (7th)** You can attempt to progress any number of the target's eligible afflictions and persistent poison damage.

  • **Full Moon** The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, AC, and saves, and a +4 status bonus to damage.
  • **Waning Moon** The target gains a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws. After this phase, return to the new moon.

---

Drawing life force into yourself, you become a beacon of vitality. You glow with [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 30-foot emanation (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) to the next 30 feet), and you gain an internal pool of light called a luminance reservoir, which begins with a value of 4. At the start of each of your turns, increase your reservoir by 4.

 If an [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creature damages you with an attack or spell while it's within the bright light of your aura, that creature takes vitality damage equal to half your luminance reservoir value. It takes this damage only the first time it damages you in a round.

 You can Dismiss this Spell. When you do, you can target a creature within your light and direct the vitality energy into it. The target must be a willing living creature or an undead creature. This heals a living target or deals vitality damage to an undead target equal to your luminance reservoir's value. If you Cast this Spell again, any previous casting ends.

---
**Heightened (+1)** Both the initial value of your luminance reservoir and the amount it increases each turn increase by 1.

<row gap="medium">

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You speak a statement that you believe to be true and that is free of any attempt to deceive through twisting words, omission, and so on. The statement must be 25 words or fewer. A symbol of your deity glows above your head and lasts for the spell's duration, and anyone who sees you and hears you speak knows instinctively that you believe what you say is true. This assurance of honesty grants you a +2 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks as long as the symbol persists. You can Dismiss the spell, and if you say something that you don't believe is entirely true, the spell ends before you complete your statement.
name: Word of Truth

<traits>

<trait label="Aura" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=206" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 380 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Truth](/Domains.aspx?ID=95)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 30-foot emanation

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 round
</row>

</column>

---

Divine insight lets you see things as they are, unveiled by attempts to magically cloak the truth. The GM attempts a [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against each illusion that is at least partially within the area. Instead of counteracting the illusion, you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against an [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159) spell, you see the creature's true form but _illusory disguise_ doesn't end). Each time a new illusion comes into the aura during the duration of the spell, the GM attempts a secret counteract check for that illusion.

---
**Heightened (7th)** You can allow everyone within range of the emanation to see through any illusions you succeed against, not just yourself.
name: Glimpse the Truth

<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 381 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Domain**
[Wealth](/Domains.aspx?ID=99)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 metal shield or weapon, 1 suit of metal armor, or up to 1 Bulk of metal material (such as coins or metal-tipped ammunition)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Your deity blesses base metals to transform them into precious materials. The metal in the target transforms from its normal metal into [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=272), copper, gold, iron, [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=277), or steel. If the spell's rank is 8th or higher, add [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=271) and [dawnsilver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=275) to the options. If you transform an object into copper, gold, or silver, its Hardness is reduced to 1. Otherwise, its Hardness is increased to 10 if it was lower. An item transmuted in this way deals damage according to its new material. For example, a steel sword transmuted to cold iron would deal additional damage to a creature with a weakness to cold iron. It can have other effects of the new material at the GM's discretion.

 This change is clearly magical and temporary, so the item's monetary value doesn't change; you couldn't transmute copper coins to gold and use them to purchase something.

---
**Heightened (+1)** If you increase the Hardness of the object, the new Hardness is 2 higher.
name: Precious Metals

The cornucopia, as well as any unconsumed pieces of fruit, wither away at the end of the duration. --- Heightened (+1) The cornucopia produces an additional piece of food. A creature can consume any amount of food from the same casting with a single Interact action. Eating six pieces of produce from the cornucopia gives as much nourishment as one square meal for a typical human.

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 382 2.0 **Area** ground within a 100-foot emanation **Duration** sustained up to 1 minute --- The ground within the area transforms into a mass of dangerous briars that assault and impede your foes. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, select one of the following effects to occur in the area.
  • **Ensnare** The briars clump around your foes, attempting to hold them in place. A foe within the area (or flying at most 20 feet above the area) must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds for 1 round, and on a critical failure, it is immobilized for 1 round unless it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79).
  • **Impede** The briars twist and writhe, making the entire area [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453).
  • **Wall** A [_wall of thorns_](/Spells.aspx?ID=366) appears in the area, lasting for 1 round. The wall is greater difficult terrain instead of difficult terrain.
In addition, once per round you can direct the briars to impale any target in the area (or flying up to 20 feet above the area) that you can see by using a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) and [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) traits. Make a spell attack roll. On a success, the target takes 10d6 piercing damage and takes a –10- foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds for 1 round; on a critical success, the target is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) for 1 round unless it Escapes.
name: Impaling Briars

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 382 2.0 **Requirements** You are outdoors and aboveground **Area** 100-foot emanation, which includes you **Duration** sustained up to 1 minute --- The sky above you darkens in a matter of moments, swirling with ominous clouds punctuated by flashes of lighting. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, select one of the following effects to occur in the area.
  • **Calm** No additional effect.
  • **Fog** Heavy fog rolls in, with the effects of [_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606).
  • **Rain** Torrential rain falls from the sky, dousing ordinary flames. Creatures in the area take a –2 circumstance penalty to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) and Perception checks.
  • **Wind** Powerful winds buffet the area in all directions. Ranged attacks take a –4 circumstance penalty, and the area is difficult terrain for flying creatures.
In addition, once per round you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) and [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) traits, to call down a bolt of lightning, striking any target in range that you can see. You deal 10d6 electricity damage to the target; it must attempt a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. On a failure, it is also [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 1 round.
name: Storm Lord

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** varies
</row>

</column>

---

You reach within for a different part of yourself, and you set it free, transforming your body into another form. You polymorph into any form listed in [_pest form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=217), which lasts 10 minutes. All other _untamed form_ shapes last 1 minute. You can add more shapes to your _untamed form_ list with druid feats; your feat might grant  you some or all of the shapes from a given [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127) spell. When you transform into a shape granted by a spell, you gain all the effects of the shape you chose from a version of the spell heightened to _untamed form'_s rank. _Untamed form_ allows you to use your own shapeshifting training more easily than most polymorph spells. When you choose to use your own attack modifier while polymorphed instead of the form's default attack modifier, you gain a +2 status bonus to your attack rolls.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** You can transform into shapes listed in [_animal form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=10).
name: Untamed Form

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 383 2.0 **Duration** 1 minute --- You transform just a part of your body. Choose any one effect that matches an untamed order feat you have.
  • **Untamed Form** Your hands transform into incredibly sharp claws. Untamed claws are an unarmed attack, have the [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170) and [finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179) traits, and deal 1d6 slashing damage. You can still hold and use items with your hands while they're transformed by this spell, but you must have a hand free to attack with it.
  • **Insect Shape** Your mouth becomes deadly jaws. Untamed jaws are an unarmed attack that deal 1d8 piercing damage.
  • **Elemental Shape** You shift your body to be partially composed of elemental matter, granting you resistance 5 to critical hits and precision damage.
  • **Plant Shape** Your arms become long vines, increasing your [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192) to 10 feet (or 15 feet with a reach weapon).
  • **Soaring Shape** You must cast _untamed shift_ using 2 actions for this benefit. You grow wings from your back, gaining a fly Speed of 30 feet.
--- **Heightened (6th)** You can choose up to two effects from the list. Untamed claws leave terrible, ragged wounds that also deal 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) on a hit, and untamed jaws are envenomed, also dealing 2d6 persistent poison damage on a hit. **Heightened (10th)** You can choose up to three effects from the list. Untamed claws deal 4d6 persistent bleed damage on a hit, and untamed jaws deal 4d6 persistent poison damage on a hit.
name: Untamed Shift

[Soothing Mist](/Spells.aspx?ID=1869)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Ranger" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=682" />
<trait label="Vitality" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=509" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 383 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You call forth a magical mist that envelops a creature. The mist restores 2d8 Hit Points to a target living creature and ends one source of [persistent acid, bleed, fire, poison, or void damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) affecting it. If the creature is taking persistent damage from multiple sources, you select which one is removed. Against an [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) target, you deal 2d8 vitality damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save); if it fails the save, it also takes 2 persistent vitality damage.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The amount of healing (or damage to an undead target) increases by 1d8, and the persistent vitality damage to an undead creature increases by 1.
name: Soothing Mist

[Ephemeral Tracking](/Spells.aspx?ID=1870)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Ranger" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=682" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 384 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You can look at currents in the air and water and see tracks that you can follow just as you would on land. You can use [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=66) through both air and water, noticing aerial or aquatic “tracks” of all creatures who passed nearby in the last hour. It's more difficult to Track in this way: the DC to Track through air or water is always at least 30, or higher after precipitation or wind (in the air) or heavy tides or currents (in the water). It's possible to [Cover Tracks](/Actions.aspx?ID=65) against this spell, but creatures might not realize they need to do so.
name: Ephemeral Tracking

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 hunted prey
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

---

Your target glows with a magical aura visible only to you and those who follow your lead. Your target is visible to you and others sharing your Hunt Prey benefits even if it wouldn't normally be due to lighting or the [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) or [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) conditions, though cover from opaque objects still blocks your sight. ---

Your patron warps the target's shadow into a deadly form, such as strangling hands, a dangerous weapon, harrying runes, or the like. The shadow moves along with the target, always remaining within reach. When you Cast the Spell, and each time you Sustain it, the shadow Strikes the target. The shadow's Strikes are melee spell attacks that deal damage equal to 1d10 plus your spellcasting attribute modifier. You choose the type of damage (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) when you Cast the Spell. The shadow uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty. The shadow doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The shadow can't make any attacks other than its Strike.

 The shadow vanishes if the target ceases to cast a shadow (usually if it moves into complete darkness or light). If another effect is controlling the target's shadow when you cast _malicious shadow_, you can attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) that effect to temporarily take control of the shadow for _malicious shadow's_ duration.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The Strike damage increases by 1d10.
name: Malicious Shadow

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
AC

</row>

---

You take advantage of one of the most fundamental lessons of magic to levitate and propel your weapon. You hurl a held melee weapon with which you are trained at the target, making a spell attack roll. On a success, you deal the weapon's damage as if you had hit with a melee Strike, but add your spellcasting attribute modifier to damage, rather than your Strength modifier. On a critical success, you deal double damage, and you add the weapon's [critical specialization effect](/Rules.aspx?ID=235). Regardless of the outcome, the weapon flies back to you and returns to your hand.
name: Hand of the Apprentice

You gather the embers of another caster's spell, using your understanding of unified magic to pick apart their formulas and incantations well enough to imitate the spell yourself, if only for a short time. You prophesize the result of the triggering saving throw as either a success (including a critical success) or a failure (including a critical failure). If you predict incorrectly, fortune spurns the target, imparting a –1 status penalty to its saving throws.

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 59 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 willing  animal 
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You use your knowledge of nature to pass the target off as a common animal of the same size, representing a species chosen when the spell is cast. This covers the target’s visual appearance, scent, and voice. The target can communicate with other members of the species as though they shared a language but can’t speak other languages while the spell persists. Casting _imitate fauna_ counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=2388) action. It allows the target to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar creatures, and it gives the target a +4 status bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks to prevent other animals from seeing through their disguise. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) this spell.

---
**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to six willing animals.
name: Imitate Fauna

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage of the cone increases by 1d8.

<actions string="Single Action" />

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=541" />

<trait label="Fear" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=598" />
<trait label="Hex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=624" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
<trait label="Witch" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=734" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 61 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Patron Theme**
[Devourer of Decay](/Patrons.aspx?ID=19)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
Will

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

With a cruel laugh and a flash of your canines, you make a target understand that death is coming to claim it and that its demise will serve to strengthen another. The target becomes [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) if it fails a Will save (or frightened 2 on a critical failure). This condition can't be reduced below 1 while the spell is active and the target can hear you. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell as a reaction when an ally critically succeeds at a Strike against the target, restoring 1d4 Hit Points to that ally.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The number of Hit Points restored when you [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell increases by 1d4.

<title level="1" right="Focus 3" pfs="Standard">
[Blood in the Water](/Spells.aspx?ID=1941)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Hex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=624" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Spirit" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=737" />
<trait label="Witch" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=734" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 61 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Lesson**
[Lesson of the Shark](/Lessons.aspx?ID=28)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Requirements** The target is taking [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) or your last action dealt slashing damage to the target.

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 creature that can bleed
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Predators are drawn to the scent of blood, and blood can disperse shockingly far in the water. You summon the spirits of aquatic predators to appear as a spectral swarm around the target. When you [Cast](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) or [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) this Spell, the target takes 2d6 spirit damage (basic Reflex save). If the target takes any damage from the spell, it treats all water as [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) for 1 round as the predators try to drag them down. The spectral predators don’t take up space, grant [flanking](/Rules.aspx?ID=2375), or have any other attributes a creature would.

If you deal slashing damage to the target while the spell is active, you automatically Sustain this Spell. If you cast _blood in the water_ while a previous casting of this hex is still in effect, the previous effect ends.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The damage dealt increases by 2d6.

**Lesson**
[Lesson of the Flock](/Lessons.aspx?ID=27)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** An ally moves through a square within 15 feet of you or uses an action that has the move trait.

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 15 feet

**Target** 1 ally
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Like migratory birds, you know everyone flies farther together. You cause immense wings to sprout from your familiar. Your familiar [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) up to 30 feet, though it must move toward the triggering ally. If your familiar ends this movement adjacent to the triggering ally, it lands on their back; until the beginning of your next turn, the familiar automatically is carried by the ally, and its wings provide them [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2372). When the spell ends, the familiar hops off your ally into an adjacent square.

<title level="1" right="Focus 2" pfs="Standard">
[Spirit of the Beast](/Spells.aspx?ID=1945)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Morph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=657" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 67 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** your animal companion
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You bring out the spirit of another animal that lives within your companion. Its body morphs slightly to take on an aspect of the animal you choose to have it emulate—for example, it might grow a pair of horns if the spirit is a bull or a tail if the spirit is a monkey. When you Cast this Spell, select from one of the following aspects.

- **Aspect of Might** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395), and Fortitude saves.
- **Aspect of Swiftness** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405), and Reflex saves.
- **Aspect of Insight** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Perception checks to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301), [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=2406) or [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=2408), and Will saves.

---
**Heightened (5th)** The status bonuses increase to +2.

**Heightened (8th)** The status bonuses increase to +3.
name: Spirit of the Beast

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 84 2.0 **Traditions** [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** 30 feet **Target** 1 creature **Defense** Will **Duration** 1 minute (see text) --- You create a spectral albatross, a guiding bird for sailors, to hover around the target. You and allies within 30 feet of the target gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attacks against the target. The target creature can spend an action to Strike the albatross, which automatically succeeds and kills it. The target must then attempt a Will save against your spell DC. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The guilt of slaughtering a bird of good fortune weighs on the target’s mind. The target is [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 for 1 round.
**Failure** The albatross hangs around a cord from the target’s neck (or closest equivalent) for 1 minute, cursing them for their transgression. During this time, the target must roll twice and take the worse result on their next Will save, after which the albatross disappears.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the duration is 1 hour.
name: Albatross Curse

<traits>

<trait label="Attack" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=540" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Morph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=657" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 84 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
AC

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You alter your stomach, esophagus, and tongue to be able to spit partially digested food with force. You can spit at a foe once you finish Casting the Spell and can repeat the attack once on each of your subsequent turns by taking a single action, which has the [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524), [attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540), and [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) traits. After your third spit attack, the spell ends.

When you attack with camel spit, make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within 15 feet, dealing 1d6 acid damage and causing the target to be [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round if you hit. On a critical hit, you deal double damage and the target takes 1 [persistent acid damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86).

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent damage on a critical hit is increased by 1.
name: Camel Spit

Your tongue extends unnaturally, flicking out toward a creature within range and dealing 2d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). On a failure, the creature is also stuck to the end of the tongue. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike that deals at least 10 slashing damage or attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) against your spell DC. The AC of the tongue is equal to your spell DC. Severing the tongue in this way deals no damage to you but ends the spell. While a creature is stuck to the end of your tongue, actions you take with the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) trait take a –2 circumstance penalty. If you move so that the affected creature is outside of the tongue's reach, the spell ends.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d8.

You temporarily shape your lower limbs into the tail of a hippocampus in order to swim away from a nearby foe after dealing a parting blow. <row gap="medium">

**Area** 1-mile burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until your next daily preparations
</row>

</column>

---

You let loose a primal howl that incites animals and beasts to join in the chorus. Doing so gives you a general idea of how many creatures with the [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) or [beast](/Traits.aspx?ID=547) trait are within the range of the spell, but significant creatures can attempt a Will save against your spell DC to resist responding to your call. You gain a +1 status bonus to your next Initiative roll in an encounter with an enemy creature that replies to your call. For purposes of using [Coerce](/Actions.aspx?ID=2394) during [exploration mode](/Rules.aspx?ID=2440), you can communicate with a creature that responds to your call for the duration of the spell. You can only make simple commands, such as approach or hide, and only understand simple ideas, such as compliance with the order or the presence of natural hazards.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The status bonus increases by 1.
name: Primal Chorus

<actions string="Two Actions" />

<traits>

<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />

**Requirements** You worship a deity
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Area** 5-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex

</row>

</column>

---

You call out to the creatures of the wild favored by your deity. You quickly summon your deity’s sacred animal (or a small swarm of them if the animal is usually Tiny). For example, you would call forth a [lion](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2866) if you worship [Iomedae](/Deities.aspx?ID=285) or a swarm of [spiders](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=474) if you worship [Norgorber](/Deities.aspx?ID=289). If your deity doesn’t have a known sacred animal, work with the GM to find a thematic one. The animal or swarm assaults all creatures in the area, dealing 2d6 damage. The damage is either bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing based on the animal that was conjured, as determined by the GM. After their attacks, the animals return to your deity’s plane.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

Your jaw unhinges as your teeth extend into wicked fangs. For the spell's duration, you gain a fangs unarmed attack. They're a [finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=602), [grapple](/Traits.aspx?ID=619), [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage and an extra 2d10 poison damage. If you have a creature at least one size smaller than you [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) with your fangs, you can use the [Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77) ability that deals 4d6 bludgeoning damage and has a Rupture value of 17. A swallowed creature is transported to an extraplanar space that resembles the inside of a snake's stomach, so when it gets free, it appears in a space adjacent to you. If you're killed or the spell ends, the swallowed creature is immediately freed.

---
**Heightened (+3)** The extra poison damage of your fangs unarmed attack increases by 1d10, the damage dealt by the Swallow Whole ability increases by 6d6, and the Rupture value increases by 9.

**Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Obsidian Cage_ Obsidian stalagmites burst from the earth as the warden surfaces, impaling enemies and trapping them in stalagmites. Enemies on the ground within 40 feet take 6d6 piercing damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). Creatures that fail their save become [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) (the DC is your spell DC).
**Depart** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Blessing of the Depths_ The squares occupied by the warden remain disheveled and broken, becoming [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366). The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with a [_mountain resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1610) and [_unfettered pack_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1733). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds, but the duration of _mountain resilience_ isn't reduced when an affected target is hit by a bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing attack. - **[Warden of Forests and Meadows](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3326)** Speed 120 feet.
**Arrive** ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) _Idyllic Panorama_ The warden's presence unpredictably warps the appearances and perceived distances of creatures and obstacles around it. Each time an enemy within 40 feet of the warden attempts a Strike or Stride action, it takes 4d6 mental damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Will save). On a critical failure, the creature Strikes a random target within reach or Strides in a random direction. On a critical success, the creature becomes temporarily immune for 1 round.
**Depart** _Fox's Insightful Trickery_ The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with [_blur_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1455) and [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds. - **[Warden of Oceans and Rivers ](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3327)** Speed 60 feet, swim 120 feet.
**Arrive** _I Am the Tide_ If the warden is summoned in a body of water, it creates a churning whirlpool that deals 10d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within 30 feet ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A creature that fails this save is [pulled](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 15 feet closer to the warden (30 feet on a critical failure). If the warden is summoned outside of a body of water, it creates a wave of water that deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within 30 feet ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A creature that fails this save is pushed 10 feet away from the warden.
**Depart** _Acclimation to the Deep_ The warden affects you and your allies within 60 feet with [_feet to fins_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1525) and [_water breathing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1755). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds, but a creature affected by _feet to fins_ retains its normal land Speed. - **[Warden of Peaks and Skies](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3328)** Speed 60 feet, fly 240 feet.
**Arrive** _Precipice Plummet_ The warden appears, flying downward from the sky and sends a shockwave where she lands. Creatures within 20 feet take 10d6 sonic damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). Creatures that critically fail their saves are [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1.
**Depart** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541)) _Song of the Skies_ The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with [_fly_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1534) and [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds.

<title level="1" right="Focus 3" pfs="Standard">
[Beastmaster Trance](/Spells.aspx?ID=1962)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=647" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 189, [Advanced Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=39) pg. 161 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 1 mile

**Target** one animal companion you can perceive
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You enter a trance that allows you to see through the senses of the target companion. You attempt Perception checks using your own Perception, but you share special senses the target has, such as [low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=416). This spell grants no special method of communication with the chosen animal.

 For the duration of the trance, your own senses are muted. This lack of awareness makes you [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58). You can't take actions with the [attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540) or [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=658) traits.

---
**Heightened (6th)** Increase the range to 100 miles and the duration of sustained up to 10 minutes. The target can hear you through the spell, allowing you to [Command the Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400) or use other actions that have the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) trait.

**Heightened (8th)** Increase the range to planetary and the duration of sustained up to 1 hour. You can communicate telepathically with the target for the duration of the trance.

[Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Baekho](/Deities.aspx?ID=299), [Bastet](/Deities.aspx?ID=50), [Isis](/Deities.aspx?ID=54), [Ketephys](/Deities.aspx?ID=110), [Tanagaar](/Deities.aspx?ID=129)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 Feet

**Target** 1 animal
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You tap into the target's senses, allowing you to sense whatever it senses for the spell's duration. If the target wishes to prevent you from doing so, it can attempt a Will save, negating the spell on a success, but most [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) don't bother to do so. While tapping into the target's senses, you can't use your own body's senses, but you can change back and forth from your body's senses to the target's senses using a [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) action.

text: Blanket of Stars Two Actions Source Player Core 2 pg. 241 Traditions Occult, Primal Deities Cosmic Caravan, The Lady of the North Star Saving Throw Will Duration 10 minutes --- A flowing cloak of utter darkness drapes over you, filled with pinpricks of light like distant stars. It imparts the stillness of the cosmos to you, granting you a +2 status bonus to Stealth checks to Hide and Sneak. While outside under a starry night sky, you're also invisible as long as you remain still. When moving under a starry night sky, you're concealed instead. Gazing too closely into the stars is disorienting. Any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you must attempt a Will save; this is a mental, visual effect. Success The creature is unaffected. Failure The creature is dazzled until the end of its next turn. Critical Failure The creature is confused and dazzled until the end of its next turn.

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Auditory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=541" />
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=550" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=629" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 241

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You amplify your voice, loud enough for you to be heard easily at a great distance. For the duration, your voice can be heard loudly and clearly by all listeners within 500 feet, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. Despite the volume, this doesn't make your voice jarring or distracting. This doesn't increase the range or area of other [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) or [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=642) effects, and physical barriers such as walls and doors still block or muffle your voice as normal.

 Your loud voice makes it easier to [Coerce](/Actions.aspx?ID=2394) others, and the acoustics assist in [Performing](/Actions.aspx?ID=2401) at a large venue. You gain a +1 status bonus to checks to Coerce and auditory [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks to Perform at a large venue.

 You can Dismiss the spell.

---
**Heightened (5th)** Your voice can be heard clearly up to 1,200 feet away.

**Heightened (7th)** Your voice can be heard clearly up to 1 mile away
name: Bullhorn

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Force" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=610" />

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 242

**Traditions**

**Deities**
[Casandalee](/Deities.aspx?ID=34), [Horus](/Deities.aspx?ID=53)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 8 hours
</row>

</column>

---

A small platform of magical force materializes adjacent to you to carry cargo. It is [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) or has a ghostly appearance, is 2 feet in diameter, and follows 5 feet behind you, floating just above the ground. It holds up to 5 Bulk of objects (if they can fit on it). Any objects atop the platform fall to the ground when the spell ends. You can Sustain the spell to move the platform up to 30 feet along the ground, to make it stay in place, or to have it return to you and resume following you.

 The spell ends if a creature tries to ride atop the platform, if the platform is overloaded, if anyone tries to lift or force the platform higher above the ground, or if you move more than 60 feet away from the platform.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The platform can carry 10 Bulk, creatures can ride atop it, and it can hover in the air, not just on the ground.
name: Carryall

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 15 feet

**Target** up to 8 creatures
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You shift the colors of the targets' outermost layer of clothing and gear to be closer to their environment when they remain still. Creatures affected by the spell gain a +3 status bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404). The changed color granted by the spell always shifts to match the environment, even if there are drastic changes. If any piece of gear or clothing affected by the spell is removed from a creature, the spell ends for that creature.

---
**Heightened (6th)** If a creature affected by this spell rolls a critical failure on its Stealth check to [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) within 30 feet of a creature that would spot it, it instead only fails its check, as the spell mildly hypnotizes the spotter.

**Heightened (8th)** As 6th rank, and the status bonus is +4.
name: Chameleon Coat

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 243 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** touch **Target** 1 Large or smaller object, construct , or living creature **Saving Throw** Fortitude **Duration** varies --- You curse the target with rapid aging or erosion. [Artifact](/Traits.aspx?ID=537), along with objects and constructs made of precious materials (as determined by the GM), are immune. - **Object** If the object is attended, its bearer can attempt a Fortitude save. If the bearer fails or the object is unattended, the object immediately takes 4d6 damage (applying Hardness normally), and the item is cursed with an unlimited duration. Until the curse ends, the item becomes [shoddy](/Rules.aspx?ID=197) and can't be [Repaired](/Actions.aspx?ID=2384), and the curse attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) any spell that would restore the object's Hit Points. [_Cleanse affliction_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467) can target an item affected by this spell. - **Construct** The construct takes 4d6 damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). On a failure, for 1 hour, the construct is [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), is [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), and can't be Repaired, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the construct's Hit Points. On a critical failure, these effects have an unlimited duration. - **Living Creature** The living creature must attempt a Fortitude save. Ageless creatures are immune. **Critical Success** The living creature is unaffected.

**Critical Failure** As success, with an unlimited duration. --- **Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.

**Range** 100 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Saving Throw** 
Will

**Duration** 2 rounds
</row>

</column>

---

You loop a thought process in the target's mind, forcing it to repeat a moment's worth of actions. The target must attempt a Will save. If the target fails, whatever actions the target uses on its next turn, it must repeat on its following turn. The actions must be repeated in the same order and as close to the same specifics as possible. For example, if the target makes an attack, it must repeat the attack against the same creature, if possible, and if the target moves, it must move the same distance and direction, if possible, on its next turn.

 If the target can't repeat an action, such as Casting a Spell that has been exhausted or needing to target a creature that has died, it can act as it chooses for that action but becomes [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) until the end of its turn.

<actions string="Two Actions" />

<traits>

<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />

<row gap="medium">

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 non-magical object in your possession of 1 Bulk or less
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You touch an object, and it immediately disassembles itself into its component pieces. The spell fails if the target lacks component pieces (such as a statue carved from one block of stone), and using it on a dangerous object like a snare or trap typically triggers it. The object gains the [broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=60) condition, and the component pieces become small enough to be hidden under normal clothing and armor. You can Dismiss the spell. When the spell ends, the object reassembles itself into its original form, appearing in your hand or hands if you have them free, or on the ground in front of you otherwise. Once reassembled, the object loses the broken condition, and its Hit Points return to the value the object had when you Cast the Spell.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The spell lasts for 10 minutes.

**Heightened (6th)** The spell lasts until your next daily preparations.
name: Dismantle

---

This spell compels local spirits to reenact a violent event of the recent past that you're aware of and name as you Cast the Spell. You take the role of the primary victim. The reenactment plays out the final 9 minutes leading up to the death or injury of the victim and the minute after. The spirits don't change form, so this doesn't help determine perpetrators by their looks. Spiritual forms of missing creatures necessary for the event manifest as needed, and missing items appear as shadowy outlines.

 Once the scene ends, you take 2d6 void damage for each ghostly apparition that participated in the scene (typically equal to the number of creatures involved other than the victim). Any creature that observed the ghostly recreation, including you, can attempt checks to investigate the event to discover new clues and information.

You turn a container and its contents into an imaginary form stored in your mind that only you can see and interact with. text: Imaginary Lockbox Source Player Core 2 pg. 247 Traditions Arcane, Occult Deity The Offering Plate Cast 1 minute Range touch Target 1 container and its contents, totaling 10 Bulk or less Duration until the next time you make your daily preparations --- You turn a container and its contents into an imaginary form stored in your mind that only you can see and interact with. The container's physical properties—the material from which it's made, any locks, or other features—are irrelevant to the casting of this spell, but the container can't contain any creatures. The container has no Bulk, and you can visualize everything inside it. You can retrieve an item from the lockbox as an activity that takes 3 actions and has the concentrate and manipulate traits. Putting items back isn't possible. You can Dismiss the spell. When the spell ends, the container returns to its normal state, either appearing in your hands if it can fit there or on the ground adjacent to you if not.

---

You project psychic vibrations onto the target object, imprinting it with a short message or emotional theme of your design. This imprinted sensation is revealed to a creature who casts [_object reading_](/Spells.aspx?ID=705) on the target object, replacing any emotional events the item was present for. If the object is in the area of a [_retrocognition_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1652) spell, the imprinted messages appear as major events in the timeline, but they don't interfere with any other visions.

 If the object is targeted with [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1646) of a higher spell rank than _imprint message_, the caster learns that the object has been magically modified. When you Cast this Spell, any prior vibrations placed on an object by previous castings of _imprint message_ fade.

You make the object [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83). This makes it [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) to them instead if they succeed. If the item is used as part of a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300), the spell ends after that hostile action is completed. <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Vitality" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=509" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 247

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Area** 1 cube 20 feet on each side

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Saving Throw** 
Reflex

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You create an immobile, invisible prison of hardened wood suffused with vital energy from [the Forge of Creation](/Planes.aspx?ID=27). The cage is a 20-foot cube made of wooden branches, each a half inch thick and a half inch apart. Each creature in the area where you create the cage must attempt a Reflex save. If such a creature fails, it becomes trapped inside the cage. If it succeeds, it's [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) outside the cage into a space of its choice. If a creature in the area is too big to fit inside the prison, the spell automatically fails.

 The cage has AC 10, Hardness 20, and 40 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage, though it has weakness 5 to void damage. A creature capable of passing through the space between the bars (typically a Tiny creature) can leave; all others are confined within. The vitality energy suffusing the wood prevents [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=632) [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) creatures from passing through the beams. Attacks with a weapon too large to fit between the bars can't pass through the cage, and the bars provide [standard cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=459) even against attacks that can pass through the gaps. Spells and most area effects (such as [_dragon breath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=499)) can pass through the cage uninhibited.
name: Lifewood Cage

---

You place a hand on an object to learn a piece of information about an emotional event that occurred involving the object within the past week, determined by the GM. If you cast object reading on the same item multiple times, you can either concentrate on a single event to gain additional pieces of information about that event or gain a piece of information about another emotional event in the applicable time frame.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** You can learn about an event that occurred within the last month.

**Heightened (4th)** You can learn about an event that occurred within the last year.

**Heightened (6th)** You can learn about an event that occurred within the last decade.

**Heightened (8th)** You can learn about an event that occurred within the last century.

**Heightened (9th)** You can learn about an event that occurred within the entirety of the object's history.
name: Object Reading

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 249 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Range** 60 feet **Target** 1 living creature **Saving Throw** Will **Duration** varies --- A phantasmal image of the most precious thing imaginable to the target appears in a location of your choice within the spell's range. Only the spell's target can see the treasure, though you can see the vague shape of the treasure—be it a pile of items, a deific avatar, or a cherished loved one or hero. The target's response to the treasure is based on the outcome of the target's Will save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with the treasure, and the duration is until the end of its turn. The target can also try to disbelieve the illusion if it touches the treasure, [Seeks](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) to examine it, or speaks to it if the illusion appears to be a person or the like. If the target disbelieves the illusion, the spell ends.
**Failure** As success, but the duration is 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** As success, but the duration is 1 minute. The target finds the treasure so appealing that until the spell ends, it must spend each action focused on it. This can include moving toward the treasure if the target isn't next to it and Interacting with the treasure if the target is next to it. (If the illusion appears to be a person or the like, the target can also Interact to converse with it.)
name: Phantasmal Treasure

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 249 **Tradition** [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** 30 feet **Target** you and up to 5 willing targets **Duration** 1 minute --- Summoning the power of the natural world, you transform the targets into a herd of mammoths, and they each assume a Huge battle form. Each target must have enough space to expand into or the spell fails for that target. Each target gains the animal trait. Each target can Dismiss the spell's effects on itself. Each target gains the following while transformed.
  • AC = 22 + the target's level. Ignore any armor check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 20 temporary Hit Points.
  • Speed 40 feet.
  • [Low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=416).
  • The following unarmed melee attacks, which are the only attacks the target can use to Strike. When Striking with these attacks, the target uses their attack modifier with the proficiency and item bonuses of their most favorable weapon or unarmed Strike, and the damage is listed for each attack. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example).
    **Melee** tusk ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), Damage 4d8+19 piercing; **Melee** trunk ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), Damage 4d6+16 bludgeoning; **Melee** foot ([agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=684)), Damage 4d6+13 bludgeoning.
  • Athletics modifier of +30, unless the target's own modifier is higher.
  • Each target can use the Trample action.
  • **Trample** You move up to twice your Speed and move through the space of Large or smaller creatures, trampling each creature whose space you enter. A trampled creature takes damage from your foot Strike based on a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save (DC = 19 + your level).
name: Primal Herd

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>
